messages:
maria: FYI security triage on a few k8s component CVEs that landed this morning: CVE-2024-3271 (kubelet auth bypass), CVE-2024-4590 (etcd persistence race), CVE-2024-5123 (cert-manager cert path traversal). Need prioritization for our clusters.
kevin: ok — which clusters affected? hosted/dedicated/private?
maria: affected: all Dedicated + Private on k8s 1.24.x clusters; hosted uses managed control plane but we must confirm cloud provider patch timeline.
devin: can you drop the minimal repro or link? security-bot: link to advisories
security-bot: https://example.advisories/cve-2024-3271
anika: triage checklist: impact, exploitability, exposure, mitigation available, roll plan
maria: quick notes from initial read: kubelet CVE needs kubelet/kube-proxy patch; exploit requires unauth'd kubelet port open (we don't expose). etcd CVE can cause data corruption under heavy compaction — high risk for stateful clusters. cert-manager CVE affects HTTP challenge controllers using file paths.
kevin: action proposals:
- immediate: confirm kubelet port binding across clusters + network ACLs
- short window (48h): etcd patch + snapshot test in canary cluster
- scheduled: cert-manager patch + RBAC tighten for cm-ingress-sa
devin: I can run canary for etcd tomorrow 08:00 PST — snapshot restore verified previously
anika: RBAC snippet to add to cert-manager SA: 
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
rules:
- apiGroups: ["cert-manager.io"]
  resources: ["orders"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
```
maria: also need to log audit for any cert-manager file writes — enable audit policy rule for "cert-manager" namespace
kevin: plan for rollout: canary (non-prod) -> staging -> prod; rollback via etcd snapshot restore and kubelet bundle
sre-oncall: we need an incident page for any failures. I'll create a runbook and slack alert on failures >5% requests
maria: tagging owners: @kevin @devin @anika please ack, I'll coordinate release windows with infra
kevin: ack. scheduled canary etcd 08:00 PST
devin: ack
anika: ack
maria: I'll open a ticket with CVE references + playbook and assign P0/ P1 labels. rough ETA for total rollout 72h if no blockers :thumbsup:
